summary: Human conversations send output shows the existing delivery status after durable acceptance, including stopped-recipient and host delivery diagnostics when available.

schema.detail: No SQLite tables, indexes, store versions or claim fields change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Stdout stays exactly the message ID line. Human sends first attempt and flush one optional stderr line, delivery: STATE: REASON, then print the ID last, preserving both tail -1 and 2>&1 | tail -1 pipelines. Diagnostic write/flush errors are ignored so an unwritable stderr cannot fail an accepted send. The existing status read has a two-second deadline, bounding the extra wait before printing the ID. Sent/staged mail is labelled queued. Failure, timeout or malformed status adds no diagnostic. Durable-send exit status remains successful. JSON receipts and client-v0 are unchanged; JSON mode performs no extra status read.

recovery.detail: An older CLI prints the same message ID on stdout without the added stderr delivery diagnostic; messages and receipts remain unchanged.
